audit.whatIsWrong: Every row disagreed with the page's own whys. The stored chart was Pantheon / Skill x5 / Pantheon; the whys describe Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / you / you / Pantheon / you, which is the packet chart exactly.
audit.why: This is a real two-swing lane: Pantheon owns levels 2-3 on Shield Vault (W, 13s) and again at his lethality item, Urgot owns 4-5, level 6 and the late game. The flat run of Skill rows erased the whole shape of the matchup.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to the packet shape, with ratings aligned and phases[1].why, phases[2].why and phases[5].why rewritten — they described Urgot winning rows that now correctly read Pantheon.

audit.why: Lvl 3-5 (his window), Lvl 6 (your reprieve), 1st item (his lethality spike), Late (you flip it) is right and now matches the corrected chart row for row.
audit.corrected: Only the unverified percent-health claim inside spikes[3].text was replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault (E) is not mentioned anywhere on the page — not in the cooldown block, not in the trading rules, nowhere.
audit.why: It is the single most decision-changing ability in the matchup. Riot's text: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly.' It is 22s at rank 1, it is a channel, and it only blocks the FRONT. So dumping Purge into it wastes your whole window, but Disdain (E) flipping him — which hurls him out of position — and Fear Beyond Death both interrupt a channel. Shield Vault (W) is also an auto-attack reset, so the auto wind-up is the tell for his all-in, not the dash.
audit.corrected: Bait Shield Vault (13s at rank 1), and when he sets Aegis Assault do not spend Purge into the front of it — flip him or cancel the channel outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed Shield Vault twice with no numbers and omitted Aegis Assault entirely.
audit.why: 13s W and 22s E are the two windows the lane is fought in.
audit.corrected: Both written in with the front-only and channel properties.
